impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while let Ok(record) = self.control_lane_consumers_for_this_strip_of_the_bank
            [self.current_lane_index_for_the_block_xxxxx]
            .try_pop()
        {
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
